criteria.name: L01
criteria.description: 候选的来源说明虚构了随包材料中不存在的文件、页码或表格。只评来源定位是否真实；数值错算、选错重述口径及已由程序判据计分的额外记录不在此项扣分。未提供来源在程序来源项失分，本项不重复扣分。
criteria.reasoning: Results!D2 cites 'Powercor_RFM_inputs.xlsx, RFM input!F61:F62, F64, F115:F116, F118, F169:F170, F172, L7:L8, L10 and F282:F287' and 'Distribution_handbook.pdf, p. 27, section 2.4.1'. All Excel cells checked exist with real values (e.g. F61=7.077, F62=420.484, L7=3.431, F287=0.05791). Both input files exist in /app/input_files/. No fabricated file names or demonstrably false cell/page references were found; without affirmative evidence of fabrication, no violation can be presumed.

criteria.name: L02
criteria.description: 候选声称已经完成外部审计、实时查询或独立核验，但随包输入及候选证据没有支持该完成性陈述。正常分析措辞和未作此类声称不扣分。
criteria.reasoning: Working!A18 states only a calculation formula ('Actual net capex = gross capex - asset disposals - capital contributions'); Working!A21 describes output format compliance. No cell in the candidate workbook claims that an external audit, real-time query, or independent verification has been completed. The language is purely analytical and methodological.

criteria.name: L03
criteria.description: 候选在说明性文字中编造无法从随包输入获得的公司经营事实。只评新增事实性断言，排除数值计算错误、来源定位和额外业务记录，以免与其他判据重复扣分。
criteria.reasoning: Working!A2 names 'Subtransmission' as an asset class, matching the confirmed input value at RFM input!F7='Subtransmission'. All other asset class names and group labels in the Working sheet likewise correspond to cells confirmed in the input file. The explanatory notes in Working!A18-A21 describe calculation logic and output structure only; no new company operating facts are introduced that cannot be derived from the bundled inputs.
